data.name: ZONE 47
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Last Checkpoint Before the Zone

This is the final checkpoint before entering the Zone. There are no firefights, no heroes, and no one is here to save the world. A single signature can decide a person's fate, and one mistake may allow something that should never enter the Zone to slip through.

Inspect documents, uncover contraband, survive deadly emissions, and decide who can be trusted.

Inspect Every Visitor

Compare passports with entry permits.

Look for forged documents, inconsistencies, and suspicious details.

Search bags for prohibited items and hidden contraband.

Use a Geiger counter to detect radioactive materials.

Every decision you make can change someone's fate.

Survive Deadly Emissions

When the sirens begin to sound, checking documents is no longer your biggest concern.

Seal the protective shutters.

Put on your gas mask.

Monitor your radiation exposure.

One mistake could be your last.

Constant Tension

Not every visitor is telling the truth.

Some will try to bribe you.

Some will beg for help.

Others are hiding something far more dangerous than ordinary contraband.

It's up to you to decide who deserves to pass.

Features

• A tense atmosphere inspired by the post-Soviet exclusion zone.

• Document inspection with increasingly difficult discrepancies.

• Bag searches and contraband detection.

• Radiation mechanics, Geiger counter, and protective equipment.

• Random events and deadly emissions.

• Meaningful moral choices.

• Progressively more challenging work shifts.

• Multiple visitor types and unexpected situations.

Every shift begins like an ordinary day at work.

But in ZONE 47, there are no ordinary days.

data.short_description: ZONE 47 is an atmospheric checkpoint inspector simulator set in a quarantined exclusion zone. Inspect documents, uncover contraband, survive deadly emissions, and decide who gets through—and who is turned away.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: High-range Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
